mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 77 degrees outside with clear skies near the Verona Public Library, and we are under a waning crescent moon. Temperatures will dip to an overnight low of 62 degrees, and please be prepared for some rain overnight.

In city news, the Verona Senior Center is looking for volunteers for their tri-shaw bike program, which offers free 30-minute rides for seniors. Also, the city is accepting applications for various seasonal jobs within the Recreation Department.

Today is packed with activities, including the Dane County Farmers Market and live music at several local spots like Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can sign up for the Girls Try Hockey event happening tomorrow at the Verona Ice Arena.

Reviewing the police department's recent log, on Thursday, July 31st, an officer conducted a traffic stop that resulted in a driver being arrested for O W I, driving with a suspended registration, and having no taillights.
Cool off with today's flavor, the delicious Andes Mint Avalanche. Culver's is open until 10:30 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
